notes:
{米|こめ} specifically refers to uncooked rice.

Rice-related vocabulary:
- {米|こめ}: uncooked rice
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ごはん：00564_gohan⟧: cooked rice; meal
- ⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧: rice plant
- ⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧: brown rice
- ⟦{白米|はくまい}→白米：06101_hakumai⟧: white rice

Cultural note: Rice is the staple food of Japan and has deep cultural significance. The word for 'meal' (ご{飯|はん}) literally means 'cooked rice.'
